_comment: Copy to <project>/.agent-os/release-docs.json and edit for that repository.
Only add this file when the detected convention is wrong for the project.
The rule this configures lives in docs/agent-playbooks/release-documentation.md.
Never put secrets, tokens, or credentials in this file.

changelog.meaning: the plain-English entry staff and Hafiz read to see what changed

module help.meaning: the in-page guidance staff see inside the changed module

staff guide.meaning: the guide a staff member opens to learn the changed workflow

what's new.meaning: the in-app release entry that tells staff a change landed
